title: Gaming compact document (table row)
description: One row of research/gaming/compact-documents.csv: a document on the Office of Indian Gaming list of Class III compacts, with its Federal Register notice and the private capture of the file (research/gaming/README.md). Built by scripts/gaming/build_catalog.py; the site's data charts and table builder read it (site/src/lib/server/data-charts.ts, table-builder-datasets.ts). Every cell is text and an empty cell is left out before checking, so 'required' means the cell may not be empty.

nations.description: Ids of Tribe profiles in content/tribes/, taken from the profile fact that cites the same list row; empty when no profile cites it (flagged).

list_tribes_column.description: The list's Tribe column as printed, which is sometimes out of line with the title.

decision.description: The list's decision column; empty when the list gives none.

listed_date.description: The date the list shows, often the Federal Register publication or effective date rather than the signing date.

document_link.description: The list's link to the file; empty when the list links none.

federal_register.citation.description: Indigo Book citation of the notice, for example '87 Fed. Reg. 35992 (June 14, 2022)'.

federal_register.source.description: Key of the notice's source record in content/sources/ (scripts/validate_records.py checks it exists).

federal_register.match.description: How the notice was matched to the list row.

capture.capture.description: Path of the private copy under research/captures/gaming/: the state's folder and the file name.

flags.description: What a reader should check, separated by semicolons.
